about_the_game:
Features of the demo version: 
You will be able to get acquainted with the beginning of the story, the characters, and even have an affair with one of them.The duration of the introductory part is from 60 to 120 minutes, depending on your choices. Please note that the game will be improved, the full version will feature improved character art, added backgrounds, sounds and music. So far, only Russian has been implemented, but English and possibly Chinese will appear in the future.

Story
Nina finds herself once again in the village of her childhood, in order to spend such a long-awaited summer there. However, everything in her grandmother's house seems unfamiliar and strange to her when the girl finds a strange book. It becomes the most important mystery for Nina.

Gameplay and features:
• This is an otome visual novel
• Start a relationship with evil spirits or become their snack!
• Immerse yourself in the Old Slavic setting with your head

short_description: A visual novel based on Slavic myths! Nina finds herself back in the village of her childhood to discover the reasons behind her lost memory and encounter ghosts of the past. Solve the riddles of memory, learn about Slavic mythology and strike up a romance with one of the charming local boys.
